thesis: The speaker argues that while culture has shifted toward organizations balancing financial returns with positive societal impact, financial markets still rely on antiquated metrics that reward an old-school system. Consequently, the core investment thesis is that businesses which correctly balance these two objectives will generate the greatest financial returns over the next decade and beyond.
